_comment: Source of truth for the Tests workflow (.github/workflows/tests.yml).
matrix_projects: one entry per pip-based suite; 'project', 'python', 'install' and 'prepare' are passed verbatim to the matrix job.
conda_jobs: suites that run in their own job (not in the matrix).
shared: ds_toolkit packages and the suites that consume them (tests, install commands, conda envs or notebooks).
no_suite: project folders that have no CI suite; changes there run nothing.
editorial: root-level files that are pure presentation (root READMEs, LICENSE, static showcase); changes there run nothing.
Any other path (including .github/**, root config files and unknown folders) runs the full suite.

matrix_projects.install: pip install -e . pymc-marketing pandas numpy matplotlib seaborn flask pytest arviz

pip install numpy pandas scipy "scikit-learn>=1.6" pyarrow matplotlib seaborn plotly xgboost lightgbm causalml==0.15.5 econml==0.16.0 mlflow optuna optuna-integration shap statsmodels tqdm joblib scikit-uplift deep-translator pytest nbformat -e ../ds_toolkit/multilang
matrix_projects._note: The Hillstrom CSV is not redistributed (no explicit license): the script downloads it from the publisher and rebuilds the exact analysis copy, verifying both SHA-256 values.

matrix_projects.install: pip install numpy pandas scipy scikit-learn matplotlib seaborn nbformat nbconvert pyarrow fairlearn pytest
matrix_projects._note: UCI Adult is not versioned; the test contract pins the SHA-256 of the official zip.
The freMTPL2freq ARFF is not versioned; tests use synthetic data and the published aggregates in outputs/ (byte-exact via the folder's .gitattributes).
The dunnhumby data are licensed and not versioned; tests use synthetic fixtures and the committed notebooks. Tests marked r skip because rpy2/R are not installed.
